name: qdi-20pct-and-niit-single
description: A single filer with only long-term capital gains large enough to fill the 0% band ($48,350), the entire 15% band (to $533,400), and spill into the 20% band, plus the 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax on the lesser of net investment income or MAGI over the $200,000 threshold.

source.publication: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet; Instructions for Form 8960 (2025)
source.pin: QDIVCG worksheet lines 6/13 (single: $48,350 / $533,400), lines 18 and 21 (15% and 20% slices). Form 8960: 'The NIIT is 3.8% of the lesser of (a) net investment income, or (b) the excess of MAGI over the threshold'; threshold $200,000 single.

derivation: LTCG $600,000 only; standard deduction $15,750; taxable income = $584,250, all preferential.
